item.title: Fox Mascot Across Three Scenes

turns.text: Put our fox mascot in three separate square pictures: riding a bike in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree. Keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, with the same flat cartoon style as the attachment. No text.

item.tests: Preserves an attached mascot's identity, clothing and illustration style across three distinct scenes.

answer_sheet.Character reference: The fox in mascot-fox.png; preserve its face, markings, proportions and orange hoodie.
answer_sheet.Scenes and output count: Three separate pictures: cycling in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Square, flat cartoon illustrations matching the attachment; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Three separate square pictures are delivered, not a single collage.
The fox matches the attached mascot's facial design, fur markings and body proportions across all three pictures.
The fox wears its orange hoodie in every picture.
One picture shows the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree.
All three use the reference's flat cartoon style and contain no text.

turns.text: Put our fox mascot from this pic in three separate square pictures: riding a bike in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree. Keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, with the same flat cartoon style as this pic. No text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Estimated cost: 15 credits total** for three separate **640 × 640** images using **Flux 2 Klein**, a free-plan-compatible editing model starting at **5 credits per image**.

Each would use your attached mascot as the reference, preserving the fox, orange hoodie and flat cartoon style:
- Riding a bike in a park
- Baking cookies in a kitchen
- Reading under a tree

All square, with no text. Character consistency can vary slightly between generated images.

**Cheaper options**
- **One scene first:** about **5 credits**, then make the other two only if you like the result.
- **One three-panel sheet:** about **5 credits**, but it would not deliver three separate square files, and each scene would be smaller.
- **Smaller or shorter:** 640px is the lowest listed image setting; duration doesn’t apply to still pictures.

This is an estimate from the listed starting rate, not a verified account-specific quote. **No generation has run or spent credits.**

Would you like all three for an estimated 15 credits, or one scene first for about 5?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—one scene first for about 5 credits.

style.prompt: Create one square flat cartoon illustration of the exact fox mascot in the supplied reference riding a bicycle in a park. Preserve the mascot's recognizable orange fox head, large upright black-edged ears with cream interiors, cream muzzle, small black oval eyes and nose, friendly expression, orange hoodie with drawstrings and front pocket, blue pants, black paws and feet, and bushy orange tail with cream tip. Match the reference's simple flat colors, thick smooth black outlines, rounded shapes and clean uncluttered cartoon style. Show the fox riding a bicycle naturally with paws on handlebars and feet on pedals, full mascot and bicycle visible, with a simple park path, green grass and trees. No text, lettering, logos, captions or watermarks.
